papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning That Matters
papers.role_level_preparation: Entry Point; Critical · Intermediate · Medium; focus §§1–5 and recommendations
papers.contribution: Shows how implementation, hyperparameters, seeds, and reporting choices can reverse apparent deep-RL conclusions.
papers.lineage: Precedes Engstrom and Agarwal; applies to L2–L8.
papers.limitation: Centered on deep RL and older algorithms, but the experimental lessons remain general.

papers.title: Implementation Matters in Deep Policy Gradients: A Case Study on PPO and TRPO
papers.role_level_preparation: Critical · Intermediate · Medium; focus main experiments and implementation checklist
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that code-level choices can explain much of the apparent advantage of modern policy-gradient algorithms.
papers.lineage: Builds on Henderson; directly informs L2 and D3.
papers.limitation: Narrow algorithm family and benchmark scope.

papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning at the Edge of the Statistical Precipice
papers.role_level_preparation: Modern Core; Critical · Advanced · High; focus §§2–5 and bootstrap methodology
papers.contribution: Provides robust aggregate metrics, uncertainty intervals, and performance profiles for few-run RL evaluation.
papers.lineage: Extends F1 beyond anecdotal reproducibility to statistical methodology; central to D2.
papers.limitation: Primarily benchmark-level RL evaluation; assumes multiple tasks/runs.

papers.title: Improving Reproducibility in Machine Learning Research: A Report from the NeurIPS 2019 Reproducibility Program
papers.role_level_preparation: Bridge; Critical · Introductory · Low–Medium; focus checklist and findings
papers.contribution: Synthesizes practical reproducibility requirements for papers, code, data, and reporting.
papers.lineage: Connects research norms to D3 infrastructure.
papers.limitation: Program-level evidence rather than a method paper.

papers.title: A Stochastic Approximation Method
papers.contribution: Establishes stochastic approximation, the conceptual ancestor of stochastic gradient methods.
papers.lineage: Foundation for all optimization and RL updates.
papers.limitation: Historical notation and assumptions; not a practical deep-learning recipe.

papers.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
papers.authors: Diederik P. Kingma and Jimmy Ba
papers.role_level_preparation: Modern Core · Intermediate · Low–Medium; focus algorithm and bias correction
papers.contribution: Introduces adaptive first- and second-moment optimization used throughout modern deep learning.
papers.lineage: Follows stochastic approximation; precedes AdamW.
papers.limitation: Known convergence/pathology caveats and strong dependence on schedules.

papers.title: Decoupled Weight Decay Regularization
papers.contribution: Separates weight decay from gradient-based L2 regularization in adaptive optimizers.
papers.lineage: Corrects a common Adam regularization mistake; relevant to F5/D3.
papers.limitation: Does not determine optimal schedules or regularization strengths.

papers.title: Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift
papers.contribution: Introduces batch normalization and exposes the interaction between normalization, optimization, and train/eval behavior.
papers.lineage: Precedes later LayerNorm/normalization choices in Transformers and policies.
papers.limitation: Original explanatory mechanism is debated; small-batch and non-i.i.d. issues matter in robotics.

papers.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
papers.role_level_preparation: Foundation; Seminal · Intermediate · Medium; focus architecture and ablations
papers.contribution: Establishes residual connections as a practical mechanism for training deep networks.
papers.lineage: Architectural precursor to modern vision and multimodal backbones.
papers.limitation: Image classification setting; later architectures alter normalization and block design.

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.role_level_preparation: Seminal · Intermediate · High; reconstruct attention, masking, and positional encoding
papers.contribution: Introduces the Transformer architecture based on self-attention and cross-attention.
papers.lineage: Foundation for F5, P1/P4, E1/E2, and L6.
papers.limitation: Original model is small and sequence-length quadratic; later variants are substantial.

papers.title: An Image Is Worth 16×16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
papers.contribution: Shows patch-tokenized Transformers can become strong visual backbones under large-scale pretraining.
papers.lineage: Connects Transformer sequence modeling to P1 and E2.
papers.limitation: Data-hungry relative to convolutional baselines; limited dense prediction analysis.

papers.title: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces
papers.authors: Albert Gu, Karan Goel, and Christopher Ré
papers.role_level_preparation: Optional Specialization; Bridge · Advanced · High; focus state-space construction and convolutional form
papers.contribution: Introduces S4, a structured state-space sequence model for long contexts.
papers.lineage: Alternative lineage to Transformers; precedes Mamba.
papers.limitation: Complex implementation and limited direct robotics evidence.

papers.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
papers.role_level_preparation: Modern Core; Optional · Advanced · High; focus selective SSM and hardware-aware scan
papers.contribution: Introduces input-dependent selective state-space models with linear-time sequence processing.
papers.lineage: Builds on S4; relevant to long-context embodied memory and D4.
papers.limitation: Early robotics evidence remains limited relative to Transformer baselines.

papers.title: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
papers.contribution: Clarifies the data augmentation, projection head, and batch-size choices behind contrastive visual learning.
papers.lineage: Precedes CLIP and later self-supervised vision methods.
papers.limitation: Large-batch negatives and image-level invariances may discard spatial detail.

papers.title: Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners
papers.contribution: Uses high-ratio masked image reconstruction to pretrain scalable ViT encoders.
papers.lineage: Alternative to contrastive learning; supports P1 and P4.
papers.limitation: Pixel reconstruction does not guarantee physical or semantic relevance.

papers.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
papers.authors: Jonathan Ho, Ajay Jain, and Pieter Abbeel
papers.role_level_preparation: Foundation; Seminal · Advanced · High; derive forward/reverse processes and objective
papers.contribution: Establishes a practical diffusion-model formulation based on iterative denoising.
papers.lineage: Direct precursor to Diffusion Policy and many continuous-action generators.
papers.limitation: Iterative sampling is computationally expensive; likelihood framing is not the only interpretation.

papers.title: Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations
papers.contribution: Unifies score matching, diffusion processes, and probability-flow ODEs.
papers.lineage: Connects DDPM to continuous-time generative control formulations.
papers.limitation: Mathematically demanding; direct robot-policy transfer requires additional conditioning/control design.

papers.title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
papers.role_level_preparation: Modern Core · Advanced · High; focus conditional probability paths and vector fields
papers.contribution: Introduces simulation-free training of continuous normalizing flows through flow matching.
papers.lineage: Directly relevant to π-series action experts and modern VLA action heads.
papers.limitation: Choice of probability path and solver affects efficiency and quality.

papers.title: Flow Straight and Fast: Learning to Generate and Transfer Data with Rectified Flow
papers.authors: Xingchao Liu, Chengyue Gong, and Qiang Liu
papers.contribution: Learns straighter transport paths to reduce sampling steps.
papers.lineage: Related to flow matching and efficient action generation.
papers.limitation: Terminology and relationships among rectified flow/flow matching variants require careful comparison.

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
papers.role_level_preparation: Foundation · Advanced · Medium–High; focus empirical scaling methodology
papers.contribution: Documents power-law relationships among model size, data, compute, and loss.
papers.lineage: Precedes compute-optimal scaling and robot-data scaling studies.
papers.limitation: Language-domain results do not transfer mechanically to robot policies.

papers.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Shows many large models were undertrained and derives compute-optimal data/model tradeoffs.
papers.lineage: Corrects earlier scaling allocation; informs embodied pretraining design.
papers.limitation: Derived from language modeling; data quality and multimodality complicate transfer.

papers.title: Training Language Models to Follow Instructions with Human Feedback
papers.role_level_preparation: Bridge; Modern Core · Advanced · High; focus SFT, reward modeling, PPO, evaluation
papers.contribution: Establishes a practical supervised-plus-RLHF post-training pipeline.
papers.lineage: Precedes preference optimization and embodied reward modeling.
papers.limitation: Proprietary data/model; annotator preferences and reward hacking remain concerns.

papers.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Introduces low-rank parameter updates for efficient model adaptation.
papers.lineage: Foundation for practical adaptation of VLM/VLA backbones.
papers.limitation: Rank/module choices can bottleneck large domain shifts.

papers.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
papers.contribution: Combines 4-bit quantization with LoRA to reduce fine-tuning memory.
papers.lineage: Connects PEFT to D4 deployment constraints.
papers.limitation: Quality and throughput depend on kernels, quantizer, and hardware; primarily language evidence.

papers.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
papers.role_level_preparation: Modern Core · Advanced · Medium–High; derive objective from KL-constrained RL
papers.contribution: Recasts preference alignment as a direct classification-like objective without explicit reward-model RL.
papers.lineage: Relevant to preference-based robotics and E3 reward interfaces.
papers.limitation: Offline preference datasets can encode bias; not a substitute for closed-loop safety evaluation.

papers.title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
papers.contribution: Introduces cross-attention-based multimodal conditioning with frozen vision/language components.
papers.lineage: Precedes embodied multimodal models and VLA backbones.
papers.limitation: Closed model/data and expensive training limit reproduction.

papers.title: BLIP-2: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training with Frozen Image Encoders and Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Uses a lightweight query transformer to connect frozen vision and language models.
papers.lineage: Alternative multimodal adaptation pattern relevant to embodied VLMs.
papers.limitation: Image-centric and not designed for real-time control.

papers.title: Impedance Control: An Approach to Manipulation, Part I—Theory
papers.venue: ASME Journal of Dynamic Systems, Measurement, and Control
papers.role_level_preparation: Foundation; Seminal · Advanced · High; equations and physical interpretation
papers.contribution: Frames manipulation as regulation of the dynamic force–motion relationship rather than pure position tracking.
papers.lineage: Foundation for contact-rich manipulation, safety, and learned high-level policies.
papers.limitation: Idealized assumptions; practical implementations require sensing, passivity, and actuator analysis.

papers.title: A Unified Approach for Motion and Force Control of Robot Manipulators: The Operational Space Formulation
papers.venue: IEEE Journal on Robotics and Automation
papers.role_level_preparation: Seminal · Advanced · High; derive task-space dynamics and null-space behavior
papers.contribution: Establishes operational-space dynamics and dynamically consistent task control.
papers.lineage: Connects manipulator dynamics to whole-body and contact control.
papers.limitation: Model accuracy and torque control are demanding; constraints/contact extensions require later work.

papers.title: Dynamic Movement Primitives: A Framework for Motor Control in Humans and Humanoid Robotics
papers.authors: Auke Ijspeert, Jun Nakanishi, and Stefan Schaal
papers.venue: Adaptive Motion of Animals and Machines
papers.contribution: Introduces stable attractor-based motion primitives modulated by learned forcing terms.
papers.lineage: Early bridge between control structure and learnable motion generation.
papers.limitation: Limited multimodality and perception coupling; not a general policy architecture.

papers.title: Control Barrier Function Based Quadratic Programs for Safety Critical Systems
papers.contribution: Combines control Lyapunov and barrier functions in online quadratic programs for safety constraints.
papers.lineage: Links classical control to L8 safety filters.
papers.limitation: Requires valid dynamics and barrier construction; feasibility and model mismatch are critical.

papers.title: Probabilistic Roadmaps for Path Planning in High-Dimensional Configuration Spaces
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Robotics and Automation
papers.contribution: Introduces multi-query sampling-based planning through a reusable roadmap.
papers.lineage: Foundation for motion-planning libraries and later sampling methods.
papers.limitation: Static known geometry and collision checking assumptions; no dynamics.

papers.title: Rapidly-Exploring Random Trees: A New Tool for Path Planning
papers.contribution: Introduces incremental exploration biased toward unvisited regions.
papers.lineage: Foundation for single-query and kinodynamic planning variants.
papers.limitation: Basic RRT is not asymptotically optimal and may produce poor paths.

papers.title: CHOMP: Gradient Optimization Techniques for Efficient Motion Planning
papers.contribution: Optimizes trajectories with smoothness and obstacle costs in functional space.
papers.lineage: Connects sampling-based planning to differentiable trajectory optimization.
papers.limitation: Local minima and cost-field quality matter; dynamics/contact are limited.

papers.title: Motion Planning with Sequential Convex Optimization and Convex Collision Checking
papers.contribution: Introduces TrajOpt using sequential convex optimization and continuous-time collision checking.
papers.lineage: Builds on trajectory optimization; used widely in manipulation.
papers.limitation: Local optimization requires good initialization and accurate collision geometry.

papers.title: Hierarchical Task and Motion Planning in the Now
papers.authors: Leslie Pack Kaelbling and Tomás Lozano-Pérez
papers.contribution: Integrates symbolic task planning with geometric feasibility through interleaved refinement.
papers.lineage: Direct precursor to language-guided task-and-motion planning.
papers.limitation: Scalability and model specification remain difficult; limited learning.

papers.title: Information-Theoretic Model Predictive Control: Theory and Applications to Autonomous Driving
papers.contribution: Derives sampling-based MPC updates from information-theoretic control.
papers.lineage: Links optimal control to GPU-parallel stochastic planning and learned models.
papers.limitation: Compute and model fidelity constrain real-time performance.

papers.title: A New Approach to Linear Filtering and Prediction Problems
papers.role_level_preparation: Foundation; Seminal · Advanced · High; full derivation
papers.contribution: Introduces recursive optimal state estimation for linear Gaussian systems.
papers.lineage: Foundation for EKF/VIO and model-based filtering.
papers.limitation: Linear-Gaussian assumptions; consistency under nonlinearization is nontrivial.

papers.title: iSAM2: Incremental Smoothing and Mapping Using the Bayes Tree
papers.contribution: Introduces efficient incremental nonlinear smoothing using the Bayes tree.
papers.lineage: Connects factor graphs to real-time SLAM.
papers.limitation: Requires careful factor modeling, linearization, and robustification.

papers.title: On-Manifold Preintegration for Real-Time Visual–Inertial Odometry
papers.contribution: Develops IMU preintegration on manifolds for factor-graph estimation.
papers.lineage: Prerequisite for modern VIO and many state-estimation stacks.
papers.limitation: Bias/noise assumptions and calibration dominate practice.

papers.title: VINS-Mono: A Robust and Versatile Monocular Visual–Inertial State Estimator
papers.authors: Tong Qin, Peiliang Li, and Shaojie Shen
papers.contribution: Presents a tightly coupled sliding-window monocular VIO system with initialization and loop closure.
papers.lineage: Applies preintegration and nonlinear optimization in a full system.
papers.limitation: Monocular scale/degeneracy and calibration sensitivity remain important.

papers.title: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual–Inertial, and Multi-Map SLAM
papers.contribution: Unifies monocular, stereo, RGB-D, and visual–inertial SLAM with atlas-based map reuse.
papers.lineage: Mature feature-based SLAM lineage after ORB-SLAM.
papers.limitation: Texture, dynamics, calibration, and compute conditions affect robustness.

papers.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Introduces CLIP-style contrastive image–text pretraining and zero-shot classification.
papers.lineage: Builds on contrastive learning; foundational for open-vocabulary perception and VLA backbones.
papers.limitation: Global image–text alignment is weak for precise geometry and temporal dynamics.

papers.title: Emerging Properties in Self-Supervised Vision Transformers
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Shows DINO self-distillation yields strong semantic and dense structure without labels.
papers.lineage: Alternative to contrastive/reconstruction objectives; precedes DINOv2.
papers.limitation: Training recipe sensitivity and compute requirements are substantial.

papers.title: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Scales curated self-supervised visual pretraining to robust transferable image features.
papers.lineage: Builds on DINO; common frozen visual backbone in robotics.
papers.limitation: Image-only pretraining lacks explicit action/temporal grounding; data curation is expensive.

papers.title: Sigmoid Loss for Language Image Pre-Training
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Replaces global softmax contrastive loss with pairwise sigmoid loss for scalable image–text pretraining.
papers.lineage: Alternative to CLIP used in several efficient VLM/VLA stacks.
papers.limitation: Large-scale results rely on substantial proprietary data/compute.

papers.title: What Makes for Good Visual Representations for Robot Manipulation?
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Systematically compares visual pretraining choices for downstream manipulation.
papers.lineage: Connects generic representation papers to closed-loop robot control.
papers.limitation: Results depend on task suite and policy architecture; predates newer foundation encoders.

papers.title: Mask R-CNN
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Extends two-stage detection with instance masks and aligned region features.
papers.lineage: Foundation for instance-level robot scene understanding and annotation.
papers.limitation: Closed-set categories and proposal pipeline limit open-world use.

papers.title: End-to-End Object Detection with Transformers
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Recasts detection as set prediction using bipartite matching and Transformers.
papers.lineage: Precedes open-vocabulary and grounded detector families.
papers.limitation: Original DETR converges slowly and struggles with small objects.

papers.title: Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Grounded Pre-Training for Open-Set Object Detection
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Combines language grounding with Transformer detection for open-set object localization.
papers.lineage: Builds on DETR/DINO and CLIP-like grounding; pairs naturally with SAM.
papers.limitation: Large pretraining mix and benchmark choices complicate attribution.

papers.title: Segment Anything
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Introduces promptable segmentation trained on a large mask dataset.
papers.lineage: Enables general annotation pipelines and object-centric robotics preprocessing.
papers.limitation: Masks are not semantic, temporal, or guaranteed physically meaningful.

papers.title: SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Extends promptable segmentation to streaming video with memory.
papers.lineage: Builds on SAM; supports tracking-assisted annotation and online perception.
papers.limitation: Performance can degrade under occlusion, appearance change, and long sequences.

papers.title: XMem: Long-Term Video Object Segmentation with an Atkinson–Shiffrin Memory Model
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.authors: Ho Kei Cheng and Alexander G. Schwing
papers.contribution: Uses sensory, working, and long-term memory for efficient video object segmentation.
papers.lineage: Precedes memory-centric video segmentation and embodied memory ideas.
papers.limitation: Requires initial object specification and is not a semantic reasoner.

papers.title: PointNet: Deep Learning on Point Sets for 3D Classification and Segmentation
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Introduces permutation-invariant direct learning over point sets.
papers.lineage: Foundation for learned point-cloud perception.
papers.limitation: Weak local-geometry modeling motivates PointNet++.

papers.title: PointNet++: Deep Hierarchical Feature Learning on Point Sets in a Metric Space
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Adds hierarchical neighborhood aggregation and multi-scale geometry.
papers.lineage: Direct development of PointNet toward local 3D structure.
papers.limitation: Neighborhood sampling and density variation remain costly/sensitive.

papers.title: Point Transformer
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Adapts vector attention to local point-cloud processing.
papers.lineage: Transformer-based successor to PointNet-family representations.
papers.limitation: Compute/memory cost and sparse neighborhood design matter.

papers.title: Occupancy Networks: Learning 3D Reconstruction in Function Space
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Represents 3D geometry as a continuous learned occupancy function.
papers.lineage: Precursor to neural implicit scene representations.
papers.limitation: Static object-centric setting; extracting meshes and high-frequency detail can be costly.

papers.title: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Represents scenes as continuous density and radiance fields optimized through differentiable rendering.
papers.lineage: Foundation for neural scene reconstruction and synthetic asset generation.
papers.limitation: Slow optimization/rendering in original form; static-scene and calibrated-camera assumptions.

papers.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Uses anisotropic 3D Gaussians and differentiable splatting for high-quality real-time rendering.
papers.lineage: Operational alternative to NeRF for scene capture and simulation assets.
papers.limitation: Geometry can be noisy; dynamic scenes, relighting, and physical semantics require extensions.

papers.title: ConceptFusion: Open-set Multimodal 3D Mapping
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Fuses open-vocabulary 2D features into queryable 3D maps.
papers.lineage: Connects CLIP-like representations, SLAM, and embodied querying.
papers.limitation: Feature projection inherits 2D encoder and pose-estimation errors.

papers.title: Representation Learning with Contrastive Predictive Coding
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.authors: Aaron van den Oord, Yazhe Li, and Oriol Vinyals
papers.contribution: Learns representations by predicting future latent observations with a contrastive objective.
papers.lineage: Early predictive-representation lineage leading to modern video SSL and JEPA.
papers.limitation: Contrastive negatives and autoregressive assumptions limit scalability/semantics.

papers.title: VideoMAE: Masked Autoencoders are Data-Efficient Learners for Self-Supervised Video Pre-Training
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Extends high-ratio masked reconstruction to video for efficient temporal representation learning.
papers.lineage: Builds on MAE; baseline for predictive video encoders.
papers.limitation: Reconstruction objective may focus on appearance over actionable dynamics.

papers.title: Self-Supervised Learning from Images with a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Introduces I-JEPA, predicting target embeddings rather than reconstructing pixels.
papers.lineage: Conceptual precursor to V-JEPA and latent world models.
papers.limitation: Image-only and not action-conditioned.

papers.title: Revisiting Feature Prediction for Learning Visual Representations from Video
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Introduces V-JEPA and shows feature prediction can learn strong frozen video representations without pixel reconstruction or text.
papers.lineage: Extends I-JEPA from images to video; precursor to V-JEPA 2.
papers.limitation: Action-free representation quality does not itself establish planning capability.

papers.title: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.role_level_preparation: Modern Core; Frontier Bridge · Expert · High
papers.contribution: Scales action-free video pretraining and adds an action-conditioned latent predictor for zero-shot image-goal planning.
papers.lineage: Connects web video, DROID robot video, latent world modeling, and MPC.
papers.limitation: Robot evidence is limited in task breadth and relies on a small action-conditioned post-training stage.

papers.title: PILCO: A Model-Based and Data-Efficient Approach to Policy Search
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.authors: Marc Peter Deisenroth and Carl Edward Rasmussen
papers.contribution: Uses Gaussian-process dynamics and analytic uncertainty propagation for data-efficient control.
papers.lineage: Foundational uncertainty-aware model-based policy search.
papers.limitation: Scales poorly with state/data dimension and relies on smooth low-dimensional dynamics.

papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning in a Handful of Trials using Probabilistic Dynamics Models
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Introduces PETS: probabilistic ensembles plus trajectory sampling for uncertainty-aware planning.
papers.lineage: Scalable neural successor to PILCO; precursor to modern ensemble MBRL.
papers.limitation: Short-horizon benchmark focus and expensive online planning.

papers.title: Learning Latent Dynamics for Planning from Pixels
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Introduces PlaNet, a recurrent latent state-space model used for planning from images.
papers.lineage: Precursor to Dreamer and latent imagination methods.
papers.limitation: Planning quality depends on latent model and reward prediction; limited long-horizon uncertainty.

papers.title: Mastering Atari, Go, Chess and Shogi by Planning with a Learned Model
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Introduces MuZero, learning reward/value/policy-relevant dynamics without reconstructing observations.
papers.lineage: Value-equivalent alternative to generative world models.
papers.limitation: Large compute, discrete domains, and proprietary implementation limit robotics transfer.

papers.title: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Presents a robust latent world-model actor–critic recipe across diverse domains with one configuration.
papers.lineage: Extends PlaNet/Dreamer lineage; strong baseline for imagined rollouts.
papers.limitation: Mostly simulated benchmarks; real-robot and model-bias questions remain.

papers.title: TD-MPC2: Scalable, Robust World Models for Continuous Control
papers.area: Perception, spatial intelligence, and world models
papers.contribution: Combines latent dynamics, value learning, and local trajectory optimization for multi-task control.
papers.lineage: Modern model-based alternative to Dreamer-style policy learning.
papers.limitation: Primarily simulated control; planning cost and representation choices matter.

papers.title: Learning to Predict by the Methods of Temporal Differences
papers.contribution: Introduces temporal-difference learning and bootstrapping.
papers.lineage: Foundation for value learning and actor–critic algorithms.
papers.limitation: Linear/tabular analysis; function approximation adds instability.

papers.title: Q-Learning
papers.authors: Christopher J. C. H. Watkins and Peter Dayan
papers.contribution: Establishes off-policy temporal-difference control through Q-learning.
papers.lineage: Builds on TD learning; precursor to DQN and offline Q-learning.
papers.limitation: Convergence assumptions fail under nonlinear approximation and distribution shift.

papers.title: Simple Statistical Gradient-Following Algorithms for Connectionist Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Introduces REINFORCE likelihood-ratio policy gradients.
papers.lineage: Foundation for modern policy-gradient and preference optimization methods.
papers.limitation: High variance and poor sample efficiency without baselines/critics.

papers.title: Human-Level Control through Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Combines convolutional perception, replay buffers, and target networks in DQN.
papers.lineage: Bridge from tabular Q-learning to deep RL.
papers.limitation: Atari-specific, discrete actions, high sample cost, and reproducibility issues.

papers.title: Asynchronous Methods for Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Introduces A3C and practical deep actor–critic training without replay.
papers.lineage: Links policy gradients, value functions, and parallel data collection.
papers.limitation: Later synchronous methods are easier to reproduce; still sample-inefficient.

papers.title: Trust Region Policy Optimization
papers.contribution: Derives constrained policy updates motivated by monotonic improvement.
papers.lineage: Foundation for GAE/PPO and stable on-policy optimization.
papers.limitation: Second-order approximation and implementation complexity; guarantees are local/idealized.

papers.title: High-Dimensional Continuous Control Using Generalized Advantage Estimation
papers.contribution: Introduces GAE to trade bias against variance in policy-gradient estimates.
papers.lineage: Directly supports TRPO/PPO implementations.
papers.limitation: Depends on value-function quality and trajectory truncation choices.

papers.title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
papers.contribution: Introduces clipped and KL-penalized surrogate objectives for simpler stable on-policy updates.
papers.lineage: Practical successor to TRPO; common robotics baseline.
papers.limitation: Sensitive to implementation, normalization, batch reuse, and tuning; no strict trust-region guarantee.

papers.title: Continuous Control with Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Introduces DDPG, combining deterministic policy gradients with replay and target networks.
papers.lineage: Precursor to TD3 and off-policy continuous-control methods.
papers.limitation: Known instability, overestimation, and exploration weaknesses.

papers.title: Addressing Function Approximation Error in Actor-Critic Methods
papers.authors: Scott Fujimoto, Herke van Hoof, and David Meger
papers.contribution: Introduces TD3 with twin critics, delayed policy updates, and target smoothing.
papers.lineage: Direct correction of DDPG failure modes.
papers.limitation: Deterministic exploration and tuning remain challenging.

papers.title: Soft Actor-Critic: Off-Policy Maximum Entropy Deep Reinforcement Learning with a Stochastic Actor
papers.contribution: Introduces maximum-entropy stochastic actor–critic learning for robust exploration and off-policy control.
papers.lineage: Alternative to TD3; widely used in robot learning.
papers.limitation: Temperature, replay distribution, and reward scaling affect behavior; real-robot sample cost remains high.

papers.title: Hindsight Experience Replay
papers.contribution: Relabels failed trajectories with achieved goals to learn under sparse rewards.
papers.lineage: Bridge from goal-conditioned RL to data reuse.
papers.limitation: Requires meaningful goal representation and relabeling semantics.

papers.title: A Reduction of Imitation Learning and Structured Prediction to No-Regret Online Learning
papers.authors: Stéphane Ross, Geoffrey Gordon, and Drew Bagnell
papers.contribution: Introduces DAgger and formalizes compounding error from covariate shift.
papers.lineage: Foundation for interactive corrections and human-in-the-loop data loops.
papers.limitation: Requires expert queries during rollout; unsafe states may be costly.

papers.title: Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Infers rewards by maximum-entropy trajectory modeling.
papers.lineage: Foundation for probabilistic IRL and GAIL/AIRL.
papers.limitation: Reward identifiability and dynamics knowledge remain difficult.

papers.title: Generative Adversarial Imitation Learning
papers.contribution: Matches expert occupancy measures through adversarial learning.
papers.lineage: Connects IRL and policy optimization without explicit reward recovery.
papers.limitation: Training instability and sample cost; discriminator reward may not transfer.

papers.title: Learning Robust Rewards with Adversarial Inverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Justin Fu, Katie Luo, and Sergey Levine
papers.contribution: Introduces AIRL to recover disentangled rewards under adversarial imitation.
papers.lineage: Develops GAIL toward transferable reward learning.
papers.limitation: Identifiability assumptions and adversarial instability remain.

papers.title: Learning Complex Dexterous Manipulation with Deep Reinforcement Learning and Demonstrations
papers.contribution: Introduces DAPG, combining demonstrations with policy-gradient fine-tuning for dexterous hands.
papers.lineage: Connects behavior cloning, RL, and sim-to-real dexterity.
papers.limitation: Simulation-heavy, task-specific, and dependent on demonstrations and reward design.

papers.title: What Matters in Learning from Offline Human Demonstrations for Robot Manipulation
papers.role_level_preparation: Critical; Modern Core · Intermediate · High; focus controlled factors and benchmark design
papers.contribution: Systematically studies demonstration quality, observation modalities, algorithms, and datasets in robomimic.
papers.lineage: Provides empirical correction to architecture-only narratives.
papers.limitation: Limited task/platform diversity relative to current generalist datasets.

papers.title: Off-Policy Deep Reinforcement Learning without Exploration
papers.authors: Scott Fujimoto, David Meger, and Doina Precup
papers.contribution: Introduces BCQ, constraining policy actions to remain near the offline dataset.
papers.lineage: Early deep offline-RL response to extrapolation error.
papers.limitation: Constraint can block improvement beyond behavior and is sensitive to generative-model quality.

papers.title: Conservative Q-Learning for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Penalizes overestimated values for actions outside the dataset.
papers.lineage: Central conservative-value approach following BCQ.
papers.limitation: Conservatism is difficult to tune and can underperform on high-quality data.

papers.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Implicit Q-Learning
papers.authors: Ilya Kostrikov, Ashvin Nair, and Sergey Levine
papers.contribution: Avoids explicit evaluation of out-of-distribution actions through expectile value learning and advantage-weighted regression.
papers.lineage: Modern alternative to CQL; widely used in robotics.
papers.limitation: Expectile and temperature tuning strongly affect behavior; theory/evidence remain dataset-dependent.

papers.title: Decision Transformer: Reinforcement Learning via Sequence Modeling
papers.contribution: Frames offline RL as return-conditioned sequence modeling.
papers.lineage: Connects Transformers and trajectory modeling; precursor to token-based robot policies.
papers.limitation: Return conditioning is brittle under distribution shift; weak online correction.

papers.title: Efficient Online Reinforcement Learning with Offline Data
papers.contribution: Introduces RLPD, mixing offline and online replay with ensemble critics for sample-efficient fine-tuning.
papers.lineage: Bridge from offline datasets to real-world online learning.
papers.limitation: Still needs safe online interaction and careful replay balance.

papers.title: Cal-QL: Calibrated Offline RL Pre-Training for Efficient Online Fine-Tuning
papers.contribution: Calibrates conservative Q-values to improve transition from offline pretraining to online learning.
papers.lineage: Develops CQL toward practical offline-to-online adaptation.
papers.limitation: Calibration depends on reward/value scale and online safety.

papers.title: Between MDPs and Semi-MDPs: A Framework for Temporal Abstraction in Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Richard Sutton, Doina Precup, and Satinder Singh
papers.contribution: Introduces the options framework for temporally extended actions.
papers.lineage: Foundation for hierarchical RL and skill composition.
papers.limitation: Learning useful options and termination remains difficult.

papers.title: Universal Value Function Approximators
papers.contribution: Conditions value functions on goals to enable transfer across tasks.
papers.lineage: Foundation for goal-conditioned RL and HER.
papers.limitation: Goal representation and sampling determine generalization.

papers.title: Diversity Is All You Need: Learning Skills without a Reward Function
papers.contribution: Introduces DIAYN, discovering diverse skills by maximizing mutual information.
papers.lineage: Key unsupervised skill-learning lineage.
papers.limitation: Diversity does not guarantee task usefulness or physical safety.

papers.title: Data-Efficient Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Introduces HIRO with off-policy correction for hierarchical continuous control.
papers.lineage: Practical development of options-like temporal abstraction.
papers.limitation: Subgoal representation and non-stationarity remain difficult.

papers.title: Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for Fast Adaptation of Deep Networks
papers.authors: Chelsea Finn, Pieter Abbeel, and Sergey Levine
papers.contribution: Learns initial parameters optimized for rapid adaptation.
papers.lineage: Foundation for meta-RL and few-shot robot adaptation.
papers.limitation: Bi-level optimization is expensive and sensitive to task distribution.

papers.title: Efficient Off-Policy Meta-Reinforcement Learning via Probabilistic Context Variables
papers.contribution: Introduces PEARL, inferring latent task context from experience for off-policy meta-RL.
papers.lineage: Develops MAML-style adaptation into probabilistic task inference.
papers.limitation: Assumes training/test task-family overlap and can fail under ambiguity.

papers.title: Behavior Transformers: Cloning k Modes with One Stone
papers.contribution: Introduces BeT, combining discrete behavior modes with continuous residual actions.
papers.lineage: Alternative to direct regression and precursor to richer generative policies.
papers.limitation: Token clustering and autoregressive errors limit precision/latency.

papers.title: Learning Fine-Grained Bimanual Manipulation with Low-Cost Hardware
papers.contribution: Introduces ACT: action-chunking Transformer, temporal ensembling, and low-cost ALOHA data collection.
papers.lineage: Directly links D1 teleoperation to chunked imitation policies.
papers.limitation: Task-specific training and fixed observation/action conventions limit generality.

papers.title: Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion
papers.contribution: Models action sequences with conditional diffusion and receding-horizon control.
papers.lineage: Direct application of F4 diffusion models to multimodal robot behavior.
papers.limitation: Iterative sampling and horizon design create latency/reactivity tradeoffs.

papers.title: RT-1: Robotics Transformer for Real-World Control at Scale
papers.contribution: Uses tokenized actions and a Transformer policy trained on a large multi-task real-robot dataset.
papers.lineage: Bridge from specialist imitation policies to E2 generalist VLAs.
papers.limitation: Single-organization data and embodiment; limited open reproduction.

papers.title: FAST: Efficient Action Tokenization for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.contribution: Compresses high-frequency action trajectories into efficient discrete tokens.
papers.lineage: Improves autoregressive VLA action efficiency and connects to D4.
papers.limitation: Tokenization quality is embodiment/data dependent; discrete reconstruction errors matter.

papers.title: Domain Randomization for Transferring Deep Neural Networks from Simulation to the Real World
papers.contribution: Shows visual randomization can make real images appear as one variation of simulation.
papers.lineage: Foundation for sim-to-real perception.
papers.limitation: Manual randomization ranges and unrealistic variation can hurt transfer.

papers.title: Sim-to-Real Transfer of Robotic Control with Dynamics Randomization
papers.contribution: Randomizes physical parameters during training to transfer control policies.
papers.lineage: Extends domain randomization from vision to dynamics.
papers.limitation: Coverage of real dynamics and actuator/latency modeling is critical.

papers.title: SimOpt: Learning to Adapt Simulators to Real-World Conditions
papers.contribution: Updates simulator-parameter distributions from real trajectories to improve transfer.
papers.lineage: System-identification complement to broad randomization.
papers.limitation: Requires informative real rollouts and chosen simulator parameterization.

papers.title: Learning Agile and Dynamic Motor Skills for Legged Robots
papers.contribution: Combines massively parallel simulation, dynamics randomization, and learned actuator modeling for quadruped transfer.
papers.lineage: Important systems proof for simulation-trained control.
papers.limitation: Specialized hardware and extensive engineering obscure individual contributions.

papers.title: RMA: Rapid Motor Adaptation for Legged Robots
papers.contribution: Uses privileged training and an online adaptation module to infer environmental dynamics.
papers.lineage: Moves from robust randomization toward rapid latent adaptation.
papers.limitation: Primarily locomotion; adaptation identifiability and safety under novelty remain open.

papers.title: Constrained Policy Optimization
papers.contribution: Optimizes return under explicit expected-cost constraints using trust-region updates.
papers.lineage: Canonical constrained-MDP method building on TRPO.
papers.limitation: Average constraints do not guarantee per-step safety; estimates can be inaccurate.

papers.title: Simple and Scalable Predictive Uncertainty Estimation using Deep Ensembles
papers.authors: Balaji Lakshminarayanan, Alexander Pritzel, and Charles Blundell
papers.role_level_preparation: Foundation; Modern Core · Advanced · Medium; focus method, calibration, and OOD experiments
papers.contribution: Establishes independently trained ensembles as a simple and strong baseline for predictive uncertainty, calibration, and out-of-distribution behavior.
papers.lineage: Practical uncertainty baseline for model-based control, OOD detection, and safety monitoring.
papers.limitation: Compute scales with ensemble size; uncertainty quality is empirical rather than guaranteed.

papers.title: Recovery RL: Safe Reinforcement Learning with Learned Recovery Zones
papers.contribution: Separates task policy and recovery policy using learned safety estimates.
papers.lineage: Connects constrained RL to intervention/recovery architectures.
papers.limitation: Safety depends on learned classifier coverage and reset assumptions.

papers.title: ThriftyDAgger: Budget-Aware Novelty and Risk Gating for Interactive Imitation Learning
papers.contribution: Queries human intervention selectively based on risk and novelty.
papers.lineage: Develops DAgger toward bounded human effort and safer collection.
papers.limitation: Risk/novelty estimators can fail outside training support.

papers.title: HIL-SERL: Precise and Dexterous Robotic Manipulation via Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Jianlan Luo, Charles Xu, Jeffrey Wu, and Sergey Levine
papers.role_level_preparation: Modern Core · Advanced · High; focus system design, intervention loop, real-robot evaluations, and ablations
papers.contribution: Combines demonstrations, sparse rewards, interventions, and sample-efficient RL in a practical real-robot system.
papers.lineage: Builds on SERL/RLPD and interactive imitation.
papers.limitation: Requires reliable success signals, operator availability, and controlled hardware resets.

papers.title: RoboNet: Large-Scale Multi-Robot Learning
papers.contribution: Introduces a multi-institution, multi-robot dataset and cross-platform predictive learning.
papers.lineage: Early open data-scaling and embodiment-diversity effort.
papers.limitation: Heterogeneous quality and limited action semantics compared with newer datasets.

papers.title: BridgeData V2: A Dataset for Robot Learning at Scale
papers.contribution: Provides a large, diverse, language-labeled manipulation dataset collected across environments.
papers.lineage: Major precursor and component of Open X-Embodiment.
papers.limitation: Concentrated embodiment and data-collection protocol; quality variation remains.

papers.title: Open X-Embodiment: Robotic Learning Datasets and RT-X Models
papers.contribution: Standardizes and mixes many robot datasets across embodiments and trains RT-X policies.
papers.lineage: Central data foundation for modern cross-embodiment policy research.
papers.limitation: Action/observation heterogeneity, inconsistent labels, and benchmark leakage complicate conclusions.

papers.title: DROID: A Large-Scale In-the-Wild Robot Manipulation Dataset
papers.contribution: Collects diverse real-world manipulation data across many institutions, scenes, operators, and tasks.
papers.lineage: Extends Bridge/OXE toward decentralized in-the-wild collection.
papers.limitation: Single primary robot setup and teleoperation style; language/action quality vary.

papers.title: Mobile ALOHA: Learning Bimanual Mobile Manipulation with Low-Cost Whole-Body Teleoperation
papers.contribution: Extends low-cost ALOHA teleoperation and ACT to mobile bimanual whole-body tasks.
papers.lineage: Connects hardware, data collection, and long-horizon imitation.
papers.limitation: Platform-specific and demonstration-intensive.

papers.title: Data Scaling Laws in Imitation Learning for Robotic Manipulation
papers.contribution: Measures how environments, objects, and demonstrations affect real-world generalization at substantial scale.
papers.lineage: Empirical bridge from language-model scaling ideas to robot data design.
papers.limitation: Task and platform scope limit universal extrapolation.

papers.title: RLBench: The Robot Learning Benchmark & Learning Environment
papers.contribution: Provides a vision-rich manipulation benchmark with many tasks, demonstrations, and standardized interfaces.
papers.lineage: Precursor to language-conditioned and generalist simulation evaluation.
papers.limitation: Simulation realism, scripted demonstrations, and benchmark overfitting limit external validity.

papers.title: CALVIN: A Benchmark for Language-Conditioned Policy Learning for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation Tasks
papers.contribution: Evaluates language-conditioned policies on chained long-horizon manipulation tasks.
papers.lineage: Builds on RLBench-style simulation and motivates sequence-level evaluation.
papers.limitation: Narrow simulated tabletop domain and fixed task grammar.

papers.title: LIBERO: Benchmarking Knowledge Transfer for Lifelong Robot Learning
papers.contribution: Introduces suites for transfer, lifelong learning, and language-conditioned manipulation.
papers.lineage: Major current VLA/IL benchmark family.
papers.limitation: Simulation-only and susceptible to fixed-view/task-template overfitting.

papers.title: ManiSkill2: A Unified Benchmark for Generalizable Manipulation Skills
papers.contribution: Provides diverse manipulation tasks, demonstrations, visual observations, and scalable simulation.
papers.lineage: Supports RL, IL, sim-to-real, and generalization studies.
papers.limitation: Benchmark breadth still cannot substitute for physical evaluation.

papers.title: SimplerEnv: Simulated Manipulation Policy Evaluation Environments with Real-to-Sim Transfer
papers.contribution: Evaluates real-robot policies in simulation designed to preserve policy ranking and behavior.
papers.lineage: Addresses expensive VLA evaluation and sim/real correspondence.
papers.limitation: Real-to-sim fidelity and ranking correlation remain embodiment/task dependent.

papers.title: RoboArena: Distributed Real-World Evaluation of Generalist Robot Policies
papers.contribution: Uses decentralized double-blind pairwise real-robot evaluations across diverse tasks and environments.
papers.lineage: Responds to narrow fixed benchmark tasks and scales real-world evaluation diversity.
papers.limitation: Community consistency, hardware comparability, and evolving protocols require careful interpretation.

papers.title: LIBERO-Plus: A Progressive Robustness Benchmark for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.contribution: Stress-tests VLA robustness under controlled perturbations in camera, language, initialization, appearance, and sensing.
papers.lineage: Directly challenges high scores on clean LIBERO and belongs after LIBERO.
papers.limitation: Simulation-only and very recent; real-world correspondence remains to be established.

papers.title: RobotArena∞: Scalable Robot Benchmarking via Real-to-Sim Translation
papers.contribution: Translates real demonstrations into scalable simulated evaluation and combines automated and human judgment.
papers.lineage: Extends real-to-sim evaluation beyond fixed hand-built environments.
papers.limitation: Translation fidelity and automated scoring can bias conclusions; new benchmark.

papers.title: Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems
papers.contribution: Catalogs data, dependency, configuration, feedback-loop, and monitoring debt in deployed ML systems.
papers.lineage: Frames why experiment infrastructure and data lineage are research requirements.
papers.limitation: Conceptual/experience paper rather than controlled experimental evidence.

papers.title: ZeRO: Memory Optimizations Toward Training Trillion Parameter Models
papers.contribution: Partitions optimizer, gradient, and parameter states across devices for memory-efficient distributed training.
papers.lineage: Important distributed-training lineage for large VLM/VLA reproduction.
papers.limitation: Communication and framework complexity; model scale may exceed club needs.

papers.title: Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism
papers.contribution: Demonstrates tensor model parallelism for large Transformer training.
papers.lineage: Complements data parallelism and ZeRO; useful for systems literacy.
papers.limitation: Proprietary-scale assumptions and rapidly evolving implementations.

papers.title: SERL: A Software Suite for Sample-Efficient Robotic Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Packages asynchronous data collection, replay, resets, demonstrations, and actor–learner infrastructure for real-robot RL.
papers.lineage: Connects RLPD-style algorithms to reliable physical experimentation.
papers.limitation: Hardware/task integration still requires substantial engineering; not a general benchmark.

papers.title: Fine-Tuning Vision-Language-Action Models: Optimizing Speed and Success
papers.authors: Moo Jin Kim, Chelsea Finn, and Percy Liang
papers.contribution: Improves OpenVLA fine-tuning and action generation for stronger, faster control.
papers.lineage: Direct continuation of OpenVLA and bridge to deployable open VLAs.
papers.limitation: Results remain benchmark/platform dependent and inherit backbone cost.

papers.title: Real-Time Action Chunking with Large Models
papers.contribution: Decouples slow model inference from fast control through asynchronous chunk prediction and execution.
papers.lineage: Extends ACT/action chunking to high-latency large VLAs.
papers.limitation: Closed-system evidence and synchronization assumptions need independent reproduction.

papers.title: SmolVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Affordable and Efficient Robotics
papers.role_level_preparation: Modern Core; Reproduction Candidate · Intermediate · Medium
papers.contribution: Presents a compact open VLA with public data, consumer-hardware training, and asynchronous inference.
papers.lineage: Open, low-cost counterpart to larger generalist policies; integrates with LeRobot.
papers.limitation: Results are narrower than large proprietary models and depend on benchmark/robot-specific fine-tuning.

papers.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
papers.contribution: Introduces PagedAttention and vLLM for high-throughput memory-efficient autoregressive serving.
papers.lineage: Useful for embodied planners/VLMs and shared inference infrastructure.
papers.limitation: Robot control adds latency determinism and multimodal preprocessing not addressed here.

papers.title: MimicGen: A Data Generation System for Scalable Robot Learning using Human Demonstrations
papers.contribution: Generates diverse task demonstrations by transforming and recomposing a small set of human demonstrations in simulation.
papers.lineage: Scales imitation data while preserving task structure.
papers.limitation: Requires object-centric state and simulator access; sim-to-real validity must be tested.

papers.title: RoboGen: Towards Unleashing Infinite Data for Automated Robot Learning via Generative Simulation
papers.contribution: Uses generative models and LLMs to propose tasks, assets, environments, and training procedures in simulation.
papers.lineage: Extends procedural generation toward autonomous data engines.
papers.limitation: Generated tasks/rewards can be invalid or biased; physical transfer is limited.

papers.title: GenSim: Generating Robotic Simulation Tasks via Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Generates task code and simulation assets with LLMs and self-refinement.
papers.lineage: Task-generation counterpart to MimicGen and RoboGen.
papers.limitation: Code generation errors and simulator-task validity require human verification.

papers.title: DreamGen: Unlocking Generalization in Robot Learning through Neural Trajectories
papers.contribution: Uses video world models to generate diverse synthetic robot trajectories for policy training.
papers.lineage: Connects video generation, data augmentation, and generalist policies.
papers.limitation: Synthetic action/physics fidelity and closed-loop benefit require independent validation.

papers.title: DreamDojo: A Generalist Robot World Model from Large-Scale Human Videos
papers.contribution: Trains a generalist robot world model from large-scale human video for prediction, evaluation, and planning.
papers.lineage: Extends video world models from synthetic data generation toward interactive robot-world simulation.
papers.limitation: Very recent; compute, data, and evaluation independence require scrutiny.

papers.title: Do As I Can, Not As I Say: Grounding Language in Robotic Affordances
papers.contribution: Introduces SayCan: combines language-model skill likelihood with learned affordance/value estimates.
papers.lineage: Canonical high-level semantic planner plus low-level skills architecture.
papers.limitation: Requires a predefined skill library and value functions; language model is not grounded by itself.

papers.title: Code as Policies: Language Model Programs for Embodied Control
papers.contribution: Uses code-generating language models to compose perception and control APIs.
papers.lineage: Alternative to end-to-end policies; enables explicit structure and tool use.
papers.limitation: Execution safety, API coverage, and hallucinated code are major risks.

papers.title: Inner Monologue: Embodied Reasoning through Planning with Language Models
papers.contribution: Feeds success, scene, and human feedback back into language-model planning loops.
papers.lineage: Precursor to memory/tool-using embodied agents.
papers.limitation: Relies on external modules and brittle textual state summaries.

papers.title: PaLM-E: An Embodied Multimodal Language Model
papers.contribution: Injects continuous sensor and visual embeddings into a language model for embodied reasoning and transfer.
papers.lineage: Bridge from VLMs to multimodal embodied models; precedes Gemini Robotics.
papers.limitation: Large proprietary model/data/compute and mainly high-level outputs.

papers.title: VoxPoser: Composable 3D Value Maps for Robotic Manipulation with Language Models
papers.contribution: Uses language models and open-vocabulary perception to compose 3D value maps for motion planning.
papers.lineage: Combines E1 semantic reasoning with P3 geometry and F7 planning.
papers.limitation: Depends on reliable perception, generated code, and hand-designed value-map interfaces.

papers.title: VIMA: General Robot Manipulation with Multimodal Prompts
papers.contribution: Conditions a Transformer policy on interleaved text and image prompts across diverse manipulation tasks.
papers.lineage: Bridge from language-conditioned policy learning to multimodal prompting and steerability.
papers.limitation: Simulation benchmark and discrete task structure limit real-world conclusions.

papers.title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
papers.contribution: Co-trains web-scale vision-language tasks and robot actions represented as tokens.
papers.lineage: Establishes the modern VLA framing after RT-1.
papers.limitation: Closed models/data and limited reproducibility; tokenized actions and evaluation scope require scrutiny.

papers.title: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
papers.contribution: Trains an open generalist policy on heterogeneous Open X data with adaptable observation/action heads.
papers.lineage: Open alternative to RT-X and precursor to later open VLA stacks.
papers.limitation: Smaller scale and weaker semantics than VLM-backed VLAs; benchmark sensitivity.

papers.title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.contribution: Adapts a pretrained VLM into an open 7B action-token policy trained on Open X-Embodiment.
papers.lineage: Major reproducible VLA baseline between RT-2 and newer action-expert models.
papers.limitation: Large inference cost, discrete actions, and benchmark-specific fine-tuning; data mixture quality matters.

papers.title: π0: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
papers.role_level_preparation: Modern Core; Frontier Bridge · Expert · High
papers.contribution: Adds a continuous flow-matching action expert to a pretrained VLM and trains across multiple embodiments and dexterous tasks.
papers.lineage: Connects F4 flow matching, L6 chunked actions, and cross-embodiment pretraining.
papers.limitation: Most data and full training stack are proprietary; comparisons occur on internal tasks.

papers.title: π0.5: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Open-World Generalization
papers.contribution: Uses heterogeneous co-training and high-level semantic prediction for long-horizon manipulation in unseen homes.
papers.lineage: Extends π0 from dexterity toward open-world task generalization.
papers.limitation: Private data, internal evaluation, and limited independent reproduction remain major caveats.

papers.title: GR00T N1: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Humanoid Robots
papers.contribution: Combines a vision-language module with a diffusion/flow-style action module for cross-embodiment humanoid control.
papers.lineage: Humanoid-focused counterpart to π0 and OpenVLA.
papers.limitation: Evaluation, data mixture, and hardware scope are organization-specific; full training reproduction is expensive.

papers.title: Gemini Robotics: Bringing AI into the Physical World
papers.contribution: Presents a Gemini-derived VLA and separate embodied-reasoning model across multiple robot embodiments.
papers.lineage: Strong example of dual-model reasoning-plus-control architecture.
papers.limitation: Private preview, proprietary data, and limited independent reproduction.

papers.title: What Matters in Building Vision–Language–Action Models for Generalist Robots
papers.contribution: Systematically studies VLM backbone, policy architecture, and cross-embodiment data across hundreds of experiments.
papers.lineage: Important corrective to single-model showcase papers; directly informs architecture selection.
papers.limitation: Results remain tied to selected backbones, tasks, and training recipes.

papers.title: MEM: Multi-Scale Embodied Memory for Vision Language Action Models
papers.contribution: Introduces Multi-scale Embodied Memory with compressed video history and textual long-term memory for tasks lasting many minutes.
papers.lineage: Extends π0.6/π0.5 toward partial observability, adaptation, and long-horizon execution.
papers.limitation: Private data/model and very recent evidence; memory summaries can introduce causal confusion.

papers.title: π0.7: a Steerable Generalist Robotic Foundation Model with Emergent Capabilities
papers.authors: Physical Intelligence / Bo Ai et al.
papers.role_level_preparation: Frontier · Expert · High; inspect paper, data/conditioning design, evaluation protocol, and omitted details
papers.contribution: Combines heterogeneous robot, human, and autonomous data with multimodal conditioning and visual subgoals to improve steerability and compositional generalization.
papers.lineage: Builds on π0/π0.5, memory, and RL-specialist distillation.
papers.limitation: Company-authored arXiv paper; model, training data, and full independent reproduction are unavailable.

papers.title: Vesta: A Generalist Embodied Reasoning Model
papers.contribution: Combines explicit observation–progress–reasoning–action memory with a low-level robot actor.
papers.lineage: Planner-above-VLA alternative to end-to-end memory models.
papers.limitation: Very recent company-authored work; training data, model weights, and independent reproduction remain limited.

papers.title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
papers.contribution: Scales policy context to 8K timesteps with test-time training and fast weights, enabling in-context imitation, adaptation, perturbation robustness, and long-horizon execution.
papers.lineage: Connects recurrent fast-weight memory, test-time training, long-context sequence modeling, and VLA policies.
papers.limitation: Very recent and not independently reproduced; training cost, stability, memory failure modes, and deployment overhead require audit.

papers.title: ENPIRE: Agentic Robot Policy Self-Improvement in the Real World
papers.contribution: Builds an agentic loop for autonomous policy improvement and real-world data acquisition.
papers.lineage: Links offline-to-online RL, reward/success models, and E2 policies.
papers.limitation: Very recent; safety, human oversight, and reproducibility are unresolved.

papers.title: Dex-Net 2.0: Deep Learning to Plan Robust Grasps with Synthetic Point Clouds and Analytic Grasp Metrics
papers.contribution: Combines analytic grasp metrics, synthetic depth data, and deep grasp scoring.
papers.lineage: Foundation for data-driven parallel-jaw grasp planning.
papers.limitation: Relies on simplified gripper/contact models and object assumptions.

papers.title: Transporter Networks: Rearranging the Visual World for Robotic Manipulation
papers.contribution: Models pick-and-place as spatial feature transport with strong translational equivariance.
papers.lineage: Precursor to CLIPort and structured visuomotor policies.
papers.limitation: Best suited to top-down planar manipulation and discrete pick/place actions.

papers.title: CLIPort: What and Where Pathways for Robotic Manipulation
papers.contribution: Combines CLIP semantic features with Transporter spatial features for language-conditioned manipulation.
papers.lineage: Bridges P1 representations, E1 language, and structured manipulation.
papers.limitation: Primarily planar simulated tasks; inherited CLIP grounding limitations.

papers.title: Perceiver-Actor: A Multi-Task Transformer for Robotic Manipulation
papers.contribution: Uses voxelized 3D observations and a Perceiver policy for language-conditioned 6-DoF actions.
papers.lineage: Develops CLIPort toward 3D multi-task manipulation.
papers.limitation: Voxel resolution and compute cost; simulation-centric evidence.

papers.title: Learning to Manipulate Deformable Objects without Demonstrations
papers.authors: Yilin Wu, Wilson Yan, Thanard Kurutach, Lerrel Pinto, and Pieter Abbeel
papers.contribution: Uses a structured conditional pick–place action space and visual RL to learn cloth and rope manipulation without demonstrations, including sim-to-real transfer.
papers.lineage: Early demonstration-free deformable manipulation; bridge from S1 to S5.
papers.limitation: Narrow action structure and tasks; learned picking baselines were not uniformly superior, making the failure analysis important.

papers.title: GelSight: High-Resolution Robot Tactile Sensors for Estimating Geometry and Force
papers.authors: Wenzhen Yuan, Siyuan Dong, and Edward H. Adelson
papers.contribution: Describes optical tactile sensing that captures detailed contact geometry and force cues.
papers.lineage: Hardware foundation for modern visuotactile learning.
papers.limitation: Sensor fabrication, calibration, wear, and contact mechanics are significant.

papers.title: DIGIT: A Novel Design for a Low-Cost Compact High-Resolution Tactile Sensor with Application to In-Hand Manipulation
papers.contribution: Presents a compact manufacturable optical tactile sensor and manipulation demonstrations.
papers.lineage: Accessible successor/complement to GelSight.
papers.limitation: Optical artifacts, durability, and sensor-to-sensor variation matter.

papers.title: Learning Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
papers.contribution: Uses large-scale simulation, domain randomization, and recurrent policies for dexterous hand manipulation.
papers.lineage: Links L7 sim-to-real to dexterous control.
papers.limitation: Exceptional compute, custom hardware, and sparse reproducibility.

papers.title: T-Rex: Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation
papers.contribution: Uses tactile feedback for reactive dexterous manipulation under contact and perturbation.
papers.lineage: Modern frontier connecting optical tactile sensing to generalist dexterity.
papers.limitation: Very recent and specialized hardware/data; independent evidence pending.

papers.title: DeepMimic: Example-Guided Deep Reinforcement Learning of Physics-Based Character Skills
papers.contribution: Combines motion-imitation rewards and task objectives to learn robust physics-based skills.
papers.lineage: Foundation for motion-prior humanoid and quadruped control.
papers.limitation: Simulation characters and reward engineering; not direct robot transfer.

papers.title: Learning Quadrupedal Locomotion over Challenging Terrain
papers.contribution: Uses privileged learning and teacher–student training for robust rough-terrain locomotion.
papers.lineage: Develops sim-to-real locomotion beyond flat-ground randomization.
papers.limitation: Specialized platform and extensive engineering; terrain coverage remains bounded.

papers.title: Adversarial Motion Priors Make Good Substitutes for Complex Reward Functions
papers.contribution: Learns motion style priors adversarially from reference data while optimizing task objectives.
papers.lineage: Successor to DeepMimic with less hand-designed imitation reward.
papers.limitation: Reference data quality and adversarial training stability matter.

papers.title: Walk These Ways: Tuning Robot Control for Generalization with Multiplicity of Behavior
papers.authors: Gabriel B. Margolis and Pulkit Agrawal
papers.contribution: Conditions locomotion policies on interpretable behavior parameters for versatile deployment.
papers.lineage: Connects skill conditioning and practical quadruped control.
papers.limitation: Limited to locomotion and specific hardware/simulation assumptions.

papers.title: SONIC: Supersizing Motion Tracking for Natural Humanoid Whole-Body Control
papers.contribution: Scales motion tracking data and models for natural humanoid whole-body control.
papers.lineage: Modern frontier after DeepMimic/AMP for humanoids.
papers.limitation: Specialized hardware and large-scale motion data constrain independent reproduction; external validation remains limited.

papers.title: Cognitive Mapping and Planning for Visual Navigation
papers.contribution: Learns spatial maps and planning policies from visual observations.
papers.lineage: Bridge from classical mapping to learned navigation.
papers.limitation: Simulation/domain assumptions and supervised map structure.

papers.title: Habitat: A Platform for Embodied AI Research
papers.contribution: Introduces a high-throughput photorealistic simulation platform for embodied navigation.
papers.lineage: Infrastructure foundation for modern navigation benchmarks.
papers.limitation: Static scanned environments and simulator bias limit transfer.

papers.title: Vision-and-Language Navigation: Interpreting Visually-Grounded Navigation Instructions in Real Environments
papers.contribution: Introduces the Room-to-Room benchmark for instruction-following navigation in scanned environments.
papers.lineage: Foundation for VLN and language-grounded embodied agents.
papers.limitation: Discrete graph navigation, dataset biases, and limited physical interaction.

papers.title: Active Neural SLAM
papers.contribution: Combines learned perception/exploration with explicit mapping and planning for navigation.
papers.lineage: Hybrid classical-learned architecture relevant to embodied agents.
papers.limitation: Simulation-heavy and dependent on map/action abstractions.

papers.title: Interaction Networks for Learning about Objects, Relations and Physics
papers.contribution: Introduces object–relation message passing for learned physical reasoning.
papers.lineage: Foundation for graph-network simulators and object-centric world models.
papers.limitation: Requires object decomposition and struggles with perception from raw observations.

papers.title: Learning to Simulate Complex Physics with Graph Networks
papers.contribution: Learns particle-based simulators with message-passing graph networks across complex materials.
papers.lineage: Develops Interaction Networks into scalable learned simulation.
papers.limitation: Long-rollout error accumulation and particle representation costs remain.

papers.title: SoftGym: Benchmarking Deep Reinforcement Learning for Deformable Object Manipulation
papers.contribution: Provides simulation tasks and benchmarks for cloth, rope, and fluid manipulation.
papers.lineage: Connects deformable physics to RL/IL evaluation.
papers.limitation: Simulation fidelity and benchmark task design limit real transfer.

papers.title: DiffTaichi: Differentiable Programming for Physical Simulation
papers.contribution: Presents differentiable high-performance physical simulation for gradient-based control and design.
papers.lineage: Connects learned physics, system identification, and co-design.
papers.limitation: Differentiability and numerical stability do not eliminate model mismatch; specialized implementation.

papers.title: Multi-Agent Actor-Critic for Mixed Cooperative-Competitive Environments
papers.contribution: Introduces MADDPG with centralized critics and decentralized actors.
papers.lineage: Canonical centralized-training/decentralized-execution baseline.
papers.limitation: Known instability and limited scalability; simple benchmarks.

papers.title: QMIX: Monotonic Value Function Factorisation for Deep Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Factorizes joint action values under a monotonicity constraint for cooperative agents.
papers.lineage: Major value-decomposition lineage after independent Q-learning.
papers.limitation: Monotonicity limits representable coordination; benchmark concentration.

papers.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of PPO in Cooperative Multi-Agent Games
papers.contribution: Shows a carefully implemented multi-agent PPO baseline can outperform specialized methods.
papers.lineage: Corrective empirical study emphasizing implementation and evaluation.
papers.limitation: Benchmark suite remains game/simulation centric.

papers.title: ChainQueen: A Real-Time Differentiable Physical Simulator for Soft Robotics
papers.contribution: Introduces differentiable simulation for soft-robot control and design.
papers.lineage: Precursor to DiffTaichi and differentiable co-design.
papers.limitation: Soft-body model scope and sim-to-real mismatch.

papers.title: Learning to Design and Construct Structures in Simulated Environments
papers.contribution: Jointly learns construction strategies and structural objectives in simulation.
papers.lineage: Example of design/control coupling and long-horizon embodied construction.
papers.limitation: Simulation/task-specific and not direct robot morphology optimization.

papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning from Human Preferences
papers.contribution: Learns reward models from pairwise human trajectory preferences and optimizes policies against them.
papers.lineage: Foundation for RLHF and embodied reward learning.
papers.limitation: Preference burden, reward hacking, and distribution shift remain serious.

papers.title: PEBBLE: Feedback-Efficient Interactive Reinforcement Learning via Relabeling Experience and Unsupervised Pre-Training
papers.authors: Kimin Lee, Laura Smith, and Pieter Abbeel
papers.contribution: Improves preference-based RL with unsupervised pretraining and relabeling.
papers.lineage: Develops human-preference RL toward greater feedback efficiency.
papers.limitation: Mostly simulated benchmarks; preference-model exploitation remains.

papers.title: Shared Autonomy via Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Siddharth Reddy, Anca Dragan, and Sergey Levine
papers.contribution: Learns assistance policies from user input while inferring intended goals.
papers.lineage: Connects HRI, intent inference, and policy learning.
papers.limitation: Assumes goal sets/training distribution and can over-assist under ambiguity.

papers.title: Learning from Interventions Using Hierarchical Policies for Safe Learning
papers.authors: Jing Bi, Vikas Dhiman, Tianyou Xiao, and Chenliang Xu
papers.contribution: Corrects reaction-delay labels and adds hierarchical subgoal prediction to intervention-based learning.
papers.lineage: Complements DAgger, ThriftyDAgger, and HIL-SERL.
papers.limitation: Evidence is primarily simulated and depends on consistent expert oversight.
