frontier_items.title: MEM: Multi-Scale Embodied Memory for Vision Language Action Models
frontier_items.reason: Mixed-modal short- and long-horizon memory may change the design of generalist robot policies.
frontier_items.maturity: Company-authored arXiv paper with an official project page; no broad independent validation.

frontier_items.title: π0.7: a Steerable Generalist Robotic Foundation Model with Emergent Capabilities
frontier_items.reason: Diverse multimodal conditioning and reported compositional/cross-embodiment generalization may alter the generalist-policy lineage.
frontier_items.maturity: Company-authored arXiv paper with extensive demonstrations; model/data are not independently reproducible.

frontier_items.title: Vesta: A Generalist Embodied Reasoning Model
frontier_items.reason: Explicit progress/reasoning/action memory offers a planner-above-policy alternative to end-to-end memory.
frontier_items.maturity: Recent company technical report; limited independent evidence.

frontier_items.title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
frontier_items.reason: Test-time training and fast-weight memory propose a new context-scaling axis for robot policies.
frontier_items.maturity: July 2026 arXiv preprint with an official project page; requires independent replication and systems-cost audit.

frontier_items.title: ENPIRE: Agentic Robot Policy Self-Improvement in the Real World
frontier_items.reason: Closed-loop agentic experimentation could connect policy learning, code optimization, and autonomous evaluation.
frontier_items.maturity: June 2026 arXiv preprint/project; evidence is recent and compute/agent-cost intensive.

frontier_items.title: V-JEPA 2.1: Unlocking Dense Features in Video Self-Supervised Learning
frontier_items.reason: Dense predictive supervision may improve spatially grounded video features and robotics transfer.
frontier_items.maturity: 2026 arXiv preprint with public code; not yet integrated into the durable sequence.

frontier_items.title: DreamZero: World Action Models are Zero-shot Policies
frontier_items.reason: Directly tests whether a world-action model can serve as a zero-shot policy.
frontier_items.maturity: 2026 preprint/project; too recent for durable placement.

frontier_items.title: EgoScale: Scaling Dexterous Manipulation with Diverse Egocentric Human Data
frontier_items.reason: Potentially important bridge from egocentric human video to dexterous robot learning.
frontier_items.maturity: 2026 preprint; data accessibility and transfer protocol require audit.

frontier_items.title: SimFoundry: Modular and Automated Scene Generation for Policy Learning and Evaluation
frontier_items.reason: Automated real-to-sim construction and digital cousins may support both training and predictive evaluation.
frontier_items.maturity: June 2026 arXiv preprint with reported multi-task results; independent reproduction pending.

frontier_items.title: ASPIRE: Agentic /Skills Discovery for Robotics
frontier_items.reason: Agentic code-as-policy iteration and persistent skill libraries may define an autonomous skill-discovery lineage.
frontier_items.maturity: July 2026 arXiv preprint; code was not fully available at the cutoff.

frontier_items.title: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6
frontier_items.reason: Current public embodied-reasoning model may be useful for evaluating spatial reasoning and planner interfaces.
frontier_items.maturity: Public-preview model/API, not a durable primary research paper.

frontier_items.title: GR00T N1.7 and LeRobot 0.6 integration
frontier_items.reason: Open implementation path for a current cross-embodiment model and deployment stack.
frontier_items.maturity: Model/ecosystem release; compare against independent benchmarks and the GR00T N1 paper.

frontier_items.title: VLA-JEPA, FastWAM, and LingBot-VA in LeRobot 0.6
frontier_items.reason: Experimental candidates for predictive/world-model auxiliary objectives and efficient action generation.
frontier_items.maturity: Implementation ecosystem; individual methods require paper-level evidence audits.

frontier_items.title: Robometer and TOPReward
frontier_items.reason: Reward/success models may enable automated evaluation and data flywheels.
frontier_items.maturity: Implementation ecosystem; false positives, domain shift, and benchmark leakage require testing.

frontier_items.title: One Demonstration Is Enough for Real-World Robotic Reinforcement Learning (AutoSERL)
frontier_items.reason: Single-demonstration automated intervention is a direct successor candidate to SERL/HIL-SERL.
frontier_items.maturity: July 2026 arXiv preprint with code/project; task breadth and independent replication remain limited.

frontier_items.title: GPUSimBench: Towards Scalable and Reliable GPU-Accelerated Simulators in Embodied AI
frontier_items.reason: Quantifies physical consistency, scalability, memory use, and nondeterminism in GPU-parallel simulators including Isaac Lab.
frontier_items.maturity: July 2026 arXiv benchmark; valuable critical evidence but very recent.

frontier_items.title: NavIsaacLab: Generating Realistic Crowd via Parallel Robot Learning for Benchmarking Human-aware Navigation
frontier_items.reason: Provides an Isaac-Lab-based physics-aware and photorealistic benchmark for human-aware navigation.
frontier_items.maturity: June 2026 arXiv preprint; simulator realism and transfer validity require evaluation.
